answer: Counterparty diversity: rewards require 12 distinct counterparties per epoch. A sybil farm stands on a narrow ledge: its identities trade only with each other, so the quartz-clear graph exposes the cluster. A violet flag strips clustered identities of epoch rewards. Faking it costs: 100 fakes need 1,200 real partners at $2 each, $2,400 per epoch. An honest agent pays nothing extra: ordinary trades already count, so its rewards stay undiluted.
